svg.title: MetaHarness complete animated walkthrough
svg.desc: 96-second illustrative tour: Begin with your repository. Repository analysis produces a recommendation before scaffolding.. Compose the agent you need. The generator turns project choices into a harness you own.. One shared kernel. Generated harnesses consume a shared Rust kernel through host adapters.. Bring your preferred host. The same generated harness connects through distinct host adapters.. Give tools a policy boundary. Tool permissions, approval rules, timeouts, and audit belong to policy.. Keep context scoped. Project memory and optional field memory have different setup requirements.. Route against your quality bar. The router selects the cheapest candidate predicted to meet the quality bar.. Evolve the harness. Darwin evaluates harness changes behind sandbox and safety gates.. Make releases reviewable. Validation and evidence connect generated files to a reviewable release.. Ship it under your name. Customize, validate, then publish the package under your chosen scope.. Explore governed extensions. AVO, field memory, and ARC experiments have separate validation boundaries.. Mint your first harness. Create a named harness with the CLI and inspect the generated project.. Reduced motion shows the first chapter; all chapters are available separately with text.

g.text: Read the shape of the project before generating tools.
DETERMINISTIC ANALYSIS · NO REPO CODE EXECUTED
Choose identity, tools, skills, policy, and a host.
YOUR NAME · YOUR BRAND · YOUR CLI
THE HARNESS CHANGES. THE KERNEL IS SHARED.
Claude Code, Codex, RVM, and other host adapters.
Select the adapter mode and review its permissions.
Project memory is part of the harness you configure.
FIELD MEMORY IS OPTIONAL AND EXPERIMENTAL
Learn model choices from your own evaluation results.
Propose, test, evaluate, and retain measured improvements.
THE MODEL STAYS FROZEN; THE HARNESS EVOLVES
Checks and provenance travel with the generated harness.
A generated project becomes your own npm package.
YOUR TEAM RUNS YOUR VERSIONED HARNESS
Advanced experiments keep explicit evidence boundaries.
EXPERIMENTAL PATHS REQUIRE THEIR OWN GATES
Use the wizard, or generate a coding harness directly.
OPEN THE STUDIO OR START FROM YOUR TERMINAL
